title.en: the big picnic at tai pak beach, discovery bay.
title.de: the big picnic am tai pak beach, discovery bay.
title.tr: tai pak beach'te the big picnic, discovery bay.

line.en: eleven hours of live music on two stages from 11:00 to 22:00, with a handmade hong kong artisan market and food vendors on the beach. it is ticketed, so buy before you go.
line.de: elf stunden livemusik auf zwei bühnen von 11:00 bis 22:00, dazu ein markt mit handgemachten waren aus hongkong und essensstände am strand. es ist ein ticketpflichtiges event, also vorher kaufen.
line.tr: 11:00'den 22:00'ye kadar iki sahnede on bir saat canlı müzik, plajda el yapımı hong kong ürünleri pazarı ve yiyecek standları. biletlidir; gitmeden önce al.

sparks.why: The BIG Picnic at Tai Pak Beach and DB Plaza, Discovery Bay, Sat 21.11 from 11:00 to 22:00, per Little Steps and hongkongcheapo.com; ticketed in 2026.
